item.title: [7.1] Gold eases after climbing over 1% in previous session
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Gold prices slipped 0.4% to $4,152.99 per ounce in early Asian trading on Friday, as investors scrutinize the Federal Reserve's future policy after recent inflation updates. US producer prices surged the most in over four years, driven by escalating costs. Meanwhile, spot silver and platinum dipped, while palladium slightly increased amid persistent geopolitical concerns.

WHY IT MATTERS

Gold prices retreated following hot US producer price data that complicates the Federal Reserve's rate path and impacts its role as an inflation hedge.

item.description:

item.title: [6.1] Articulation Upper Bounds for Language Models
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Language captures only a subset of the perceptions, intuitions and intents that form meaning between speakers. What, then, are the limits of language? We take steps towards measuring this in LLMs as follows: for a set of concepts, we measure how well each concept can be transmitted between two LLMs as their capabilities scale.

item.title: [6.0] FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. A fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored, while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. Alternatively, sparse attention with continued pretraining (CPT) can extend the effective context length.
